categories.evidence: Labeled with 'Tests' and adds unit test vectors to `src/test/data/script_tests.json` covering script interpreter validation edge cases.
categories.rationale: Adds test vectors to `script_tests.json` covering boundary conditions in script interpreter signature and public key validation. The change provides worthwhile coverage of high-risk consensus and policy code paths identified via mutation testing in `src/script/interpreter.cpp`, though it exercises synthetic mutants rather than catching an active regression.
